meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 把你要求的功能或任务拆成分阶段实施计划:先派子代理查文档、列出可用 API 和可复制的示例位置,再逐阶段给出任务与验证清单,最后加一个验证阶段。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一个功能、一项任务或多步骤实现时触发,尤其是在用 do 执行之前。

say.text: 帮我给这个新功能写一份分阶段实施计划
say.note: 会先查文档,再分阶段列任务

say.text: 规划一下重构登录模块,先查清有哪些可用 API
say.note: 子代理会先报来源再写计划

say.text: 给这个多步骤任务做计划,最后带上验证步骤

howto.what_en: Claude turns your feature or task request into a phased implementation plan: subagents gather docs first, listing allowed APIs and copy-ready examples, then each phase gets tasks and a verification checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Write a phased implementation plan for this new feature
say_en.note: It discovers docs first, then lists phases

say_en.text: Plan the login module refactor and find which APIs exist
Make a plan for this multi-step task with verification steps
